description: This Java class 'TimeBasedBuffer' implements a data buffer that holds timestamped values for the last specified duration of seconds. It manages a time-ordered collection of values, providing methods to add values, clear the buffer, retrieve current size, and get all values within the buffer's duration.

classes.name: TimeBasedBuffer
classes.description: A buffer class that stores timestamped double values for the last specified duration (in milliseconds) using a TreeMap to keep the data ordered by timestamp. It offers thread-safe methods to add, clear, and retrieve data.

methods.name: TimeBasedBuffer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the buffer with a specified duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Private method that removes all entries older than the current time minus the buffer duration.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all values from the buffer.

methods.name: currentTimeMillis
methods.description: Returns the current system time in milliseconds.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new value with the current timestamp to the buffer in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of values in the buffer after truncating old entries.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves all the buffered values as an array of doubles, after removing outdated entries.
